title: Frictionless Econ Pipeline: Validation & Rollout Playbook for Adaptive Batching, Caching, and Quant Profiles
creator: Ava Cho
description: Create a reproducible, low-friction playbook to validate and roll out combined adaptive serving knobs (batching profiles, KV-prefetch heuristics, and quantization tiers) across hosted and dedicated modes. Playbook goal: deliver >18% net unit-cost reduction on targeted workloads without violating latency SLOs or causing measurable quality regressions. This ticket coordinates experiments, telemetry, QA gates, and a staged rollout procedure with automatic rollback criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Defined experiment matrix covering 3 batching profiles, 2 KV-prefetch strategies, and 3 quant tiers with clear ownership
Automated dashboards showing cost-per-1k-tokens, p50/p95 latency, GPU utilization, and quality delta for each cell
Safety gates in place: if quality regressions exceed 1.5% absolute or p95 latency degrades >20% the rollout halts automatically
Canary rollout automation (0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) implemented with ability to pin per-customer tier
Documentation and runbook published to Confluence and linked from Console rollout page
Post-rollback postmortem template created and integrated into incident flow
notes: Hypothesis: adaptive batching + modest quantization yields most savings for assistant-style workloads with long-context prompts
We will prioritize workloads that account for >=40% of host token spend in Q1 to maximize early ROI
Start experiments in hosted region us-west-2 on nvidia-a40 equivalent to match production

rollout_plan: Stage 0: internal-only shadow runs for 2 days against production traces
